hekouwang-stock-data-reader-skill 0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for fast, compliant A-share stock data reading and analysis.
- Given a stock code, fetches public data via akshare (capital flows, top trader data, valuation bands, financials, business breakdown, northbound funds, daily K-line).
- Calculates a fixed indicator system: price trajectory, main capital inflow/outflow, seat structure, profit quality, profit composition, valuation, risk clues.
- Produces publish-ready, neutral reports with charts for public finance accounts (WeChat/Headline), including built-in compliance safeguards—never gives recommendations or price predictions.
- Strictly restricts output to compliant channels and auto-inserts risk warnings.
